zh.title: 長榮航空787機隊導入Arc 3D飛行地圖　777-300ER將陸續升級
zh.summary: 長榮航空已在波音787機隊提供Panasonic Avionics Arc 3D互動式飛行地圖，777-300ER機隊將分批更新，未來A350-1000也將搭載；新介面新增15種以上視角、城市景點資訊及兒童探索模式。
body: 長榮航空（EVA Air）持續更新長程客機的機上娛樂服務。根據長榮航空目前公布的飛行羅盤服務資訊，波音787機隊已提供Panasonic Avionics Arc™ 3D立體飛行地圖，波音777-300ER機隊則將陸續安排升級。這項更新以互動式地圖、立體視角及目的地資訊為主，讓旅客除查看飛行進度外，也能透過座椅螢幕探索航線周邊地理環境。
長榮航空自2018年起陸續在部分波音777-300ER及787客機配置Panasonic的3D飛行羅盤。依此次提供的機隊升級資訊，相關777-300ER涵蓋B-16718至B-16740的註冊編號範圍；不過，航空公司公開資料尚未提供逐架升級名單。原有飛行地圖已可顯示航機位置、高度、飛行進度與預計抵達時間，新一代Arc 3D則進一步強化畫面細節及互動操作。
長榮航空於2025年12月18日公布導入計畫，當時預告新系統自2026年第一季起陸續上線；Panasonic Avionics則於2026年5月13日發布合作消息，確認Arc平台將涵蓋波音787、777-300ER及未來交付的空中巴士A350-1000。依長榮航空目前的服務頁面，Arc 3D已在787機隊提供，而777-300ER仍處於後續分批更新安排。
Arc 3D主打高解析度立體地圖與流暢的互動介面，旅客可切換超過15種觀看視角，包括窗外、俯瞰、跟隨航機及模擬駕駛艙等模式。系統也加入特定城市的街道地圖與景點介紹，讓旅客在飛行途中瀏覽目的地相關資訊。
新系統另設有兒童探索模式（Arc for Young Explorers），以恐龍及史前生物主題動畫搭配即時飛行資料，讓家庭旅客透過地圖認識航線所經地區；Arc Vistas則以動態景緻畫面呈現飛行過程。這些功能屬於機上娛樂介面的更新，並非航機駕駛艙導航設備變更。
在升級作業方面，依此次取得的作業資訊，各機隊首架航機完成安裝後，將安排數天的功能測試，以確認系統顯示及操作正常。不過，長榮航空與Panasonic目前公開的資料尚未列出各機隊首架測試航機、測試日期或777-300ER逐架完成時間，實際服務仍以旅客所搭乘航機的設備為準。
長榮航空與Panasonic Avionics先前亦在2024年公布涵蓋54架航機的機上娛樂與連線服務合作，其中包括為14架現役777-300ER及18架新購A350-1000採用Astrova座椅娛樂系統與相關數位服務。Arc 3D為飛行地圖應用程式，其陸續導入不應直接等同於所有適用航機均已同步完成整套座椅螢幕汰換。

en.title: EVA Air Rolls Out Panasonic Arc 3D Maps on 787 Fleet as 777-300ER Upgrades Follow
en.summary: EVA Air now offers Panasonic Avionics' Arc 3D interactive moving map on its Boeing 787 fleet, with Boeing 777-300ER upgrades to follow. Future A350-1000s will also feature the system, which adds more than 15 viewing angles, destination content and a children's exploration mode.
body: EVA Air is continuing to refresh its long-haul in-flight entertainment offering. The carrier's current moving-map information confirms that Panasonic Avionics' Arc™ 3D map is available on its Boeing 787 fleet, while Boeing 777-300ER aircraft are scheduled for phased upgrades. The interactive application adds three-dimensional views and destination content alongside conventional flight progress information.

EVA Air began introducing Panasonic 3D moving maps on selected Boeing 777-300ER and 787 aircraft in 2018. According to fleet-upgrade information supplied for this report, the relevant 777-300ER registrations fall within the B-16718 to B-16740 range, although the airline has not published an aircraft-by-aircraft upgrade list. Earlier moving maps already provided position, altitude, journey progress and estimated arrival information; Arc 3D expands the visual detail and interactivity.

EVA Air announced the Arc 3D rollout on December 18, 2025, initially targeting service introduction from the first quarter of 2026. Panasonic Avionics followed with an announcement on May 13, 2026, identifying the Boeing 787, 777-300ER and future Airbus A350-1000 fleet as part of the program. EVA Air's current service page lists the system on the 787 fleet and says 777-300ER upgrades will follow.

The new interface offers high-definition 3D mapping and more than 15 viewing angles, including window-side, overhead, aircraft-following and cockpit-style perspectives. Street-level maps for selected cities also allow passengers to explore destination attractions during their flight.

Arc for Young Explorers adds dinosaur-themed animations and real-time flight data, offering families an educational view of the areas beneath the aircraft. Arc Vistas provides animated scenic displays. These are enhancements to the passenger entertainment interface, not changes to the aircraft's flight-deck navigation equipment.

Rollout information provided for this report indicates that the first aircraft fitted in each fleet will undergo several days of functional testing to check map displays and operation. EVA Air and Panasonic Avionics have not publicly identified those test aircraft, their test dates or a registration-by-registration completion schedule for the 777-300ERs. Actual availability remains aircraft-dependent.

EVA Air and Panasonic Avionics also announced a 54-aircraft entertainment and connectivity agreement in 2024. That agreement included Astrova seatback entertainment installations on 14 existing 777-300ERs and 18 incoming A350-1000s. Arc 3D is a moving-map application, and its rollout should not be taken to mean that every aircraft receiving the software has also completed a full seatback-screen replacement.
